title: Engineering review 2026-10-17: structural improvements
description: Follow-ups from the code-level engineering review of develop at b6dd747 (doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/9740d727-91b0-4ed3-a0db-3c6b743e8f20). Yesterday's acceptance review (label acceptance-review) tested the product from the outside; this epic goes underneath it: performance root causes, security gaps in the local and cloud consoles, data-integrity gaps between the Rust and Python runtimes, router process hygiene, CI and release drift, and documentation that disagrees with the code. Each child task is written so a worker can pick it up without the doc. Order: data integrity and security first (tasks marked priority 1), then speed, then process and hygiene.
